{{Quote|We've had no further contact with General Plo Koon. The absence of distress beacons indicates that his fleet was&hellip; That his fleet was destroyed like the others. We are about to prepare a rescue mission.|Anakin Skywalker, to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi High Council|audio=NoFurtherContactRescueMission.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
The '''Battle of Abregado''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle that took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|defeat]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune's]] task force in the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] at the hands of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] took several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to find and destroy the ship. Koon tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], but the warship attacked his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]], and the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were left defenseless. Shortly before the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] fell to [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire, several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] managed to flee in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], and Koon escaped in a pod with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe," [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]], and [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] [[Boost/Legends|Boost]].

Dooku dispatched several [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding craft]] with [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the survivors, as he did not want the survivors to inform the Republic of the ''Malevolence''. Only Koon and the three [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] in his pod were able to defeat the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] who came in search of survivors. Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], soon arrived in the system aboard Skywalker's personal ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], and they rescued Koon and the clones. The ''Twilight'' encountered the ''Malevolence'', but the Jedi and clones successfully evaded a wave from the warship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] by jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Their escape brought the knowledge of the nature of the weapon to the Republic.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have recommended an increase in patrols along the region. I will lead the sweeps in the ''Triumphant'' and maintain constant communication.|Plo Koon volunteers to lead a hunt for the ''Malevolence''|<ref name="Shakedown" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], capable of neutralizing all power in its enemies with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. Blasts from the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] left the ship's targets defenseless and vulnerable to [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from the ''Malevolence'' without the ability to use [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' began a [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|series of strikes]] on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task forces that left no survivors to tell the Republic of the weapon's origins or methods of attack.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> The attacks did not form a pattern, and the unpredictability of future targets spread fear throughout the Republic.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|defeat]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune's]] patrol of several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] met with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to discuss methods to protect more Republic fleets from being destroyed. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] volunteered to take several ''Venator''-class cruisers&mdash;including his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']]&mdash;to find and eliminate the Confederate weapon.<ref name="Shakedown" /> Koon's forces were supported by the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]].<ref name="Hasbro Clones Video" />

==The battle==
===''Malevolence'' attack===
{{Quote|We're losing all our power! That energy field has left us ''defenseless''!|Commander Wolffe, shortly after the ''Malevolence'' fires its ion cannons at their fleet|audio=LeftUsDefenseless.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Malevolence_destroys_Venators.png|thumb|left|250px|Plo Koon's fleet is destroyed by the ''Malevolence''.]]
Plo Koon and his forces tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]] and approached the vessel. Koon intended to report as much information on the weapon as possible in case of his defeat, and before proceeding, he contacted Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> who were keeping the nearby [[Bith system/Legends|Bith system]]<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> secure.<ref name="Shakedown" /> The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], had arrived aboard the ''Malevolence'' to observe General Grievous' progress, and ordered the Republic task force's transmissions to be jammed.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> After Koon and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe,"<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> reported their position to Skywalker and Tano, their communications were cut.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

Seeing this as an opportunity for another test of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], Grievous ordered the weapon to be fired. The Confederate warship moved to attack Koon's fleet, and because they were out of range, the Republic cruisers were unable to open fire. The ''Malevolence'' discharged its cannons; as the wave approached, Koon and the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] braced themselves for impact. The wave passed over the fleet and neutralized the cruisers' shields, and the vulnerable cruisers fell to fire from the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} numerous laser cannons. Shortly before the ''Triumphant'' was destroyed, Plo Koon and several clone troopers were able to flee from the cruiser in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. As Koon's fleet was ripped apart, a debris field&mdash;from the wreckage of the three destroyed cruisers&mdash;was scattered in the Abregado system. The power of the escape pod containing Koon, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]], and trooper [[Boost/Legends|Boost]]<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> depleted, leaving the pod without life support or access to communication channels.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

Following the loss of contact from Plo Koon, Skywalker and Tano entered into a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-meeting with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi Council. Skywalker reported Koon's position in the Abregado system before communications had been cut, and suggested that the absence of distress beacons implied that his fleet had been destroyed. Battle groups were reassigned to protect the Republic's supply convoys, including Skywalker's fleet. The Jedi Council ordered Skywalker to reposition his fleet without searching for survivors of the attack on Koon's forces.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was to protect the convoys while Skywalker went to scout ahead for enemy activity with Tano in his personal [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. The two headed for the Abregado system, however, as Skywalker intended to search for survivors, against the Jedi Council's orders.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" />

Skywalker, Tano and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived in the system aboard the ''Twilight''. Entering the debris field, R2-D2 activated the ship's scanners in search of surviving life forms in the battlefield. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] contacted the ship, and upon hearing that Skywalker and Tano had not found any survivors, Kenobi ordered Skywalker to rendezvous back with his fleet. R2-D2 picked up a signal on the emergency channel, and Tano began to put out a signal through the emergency communication channel, trying to make contact with any remaining survivors of the battle.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

===Hunt for the pods===
{{Quote|Send out the hunters. I want all of those life pods ''destroyed''.|Count Dooku|audio=SendOutTheHunters.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Rocket_Battle_Droids.png|thumb|right|230px|Rocket battle droids split open Pod 1977.]]
[[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku did not want to risk the chance that the survivors would inform the Republic of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannons and dispatched several [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding craft]] with [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] aboard&mdash;nicknamed "pod hunters"&mdash;to destroy the escape pods. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] split several of the pods open, leaving the clones inside vulnerable to the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The clones restored the power in Koon's pod, and were able to gain access to the communication channels. Receiving a signal from another escape pod,<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> [[Pod 1977/Legends|Pod 1977]],<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> the Jedi and the troopers soon witnessed its destruction at the hands of the hunters. By this time, the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had destroyed all the pods except for the one containing Koon and the clones. Noticing the remaining pod, the battle droids approached it and prepared to destroy it.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

As the Confederate craft neared the last surviving pod, Koon decided to personally confront the droids,<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> as his [[Kel Dor/Legends|species]] was able to withstand the pressure of space for a brief amount of time.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> Sinker and Boost used their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor suits]] to receive oxygen and accompanied the Jedi, leaving Wolffe inside the pod to keep the communication signal alive, as it was the only chance for their rescue. The craft latched onto the pod with its "pincers," and as the rocket droids approached and prepared to slice the pod's view hole open, Koon and the two clones attacked the droids. The droids retreated into the craft and activated the craft's squeeze mechanism, intending to crush the pod with the its pincers. Koon used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] Sinker behind the craft where the droids were situated, and the clone eliminated most of the battle droids with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

In the pod, Wolffe picked up Tano's signal. He was unable to return a message, however, as the crushing of the pod caused Wolffe to lose the signal. Koon, still outside the escape pod, severed the Confederate craft's legs, breaking its grip on the escape pod. Then, Koon Force-pushed the craft away and pulled Sinker back toward the pod. The craft hit a piece of debris from the destroyed ''Venator''-class cruisers and exploded, and the loss of contact with the craft alerted the ''Malevolence'' to the possibility of remaining survivors.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

===Rescue===
{{Quote|I ''know'' he's alive! I can sense it!''"<br />"''Ahsoka!|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, on Master Plo Koon|audio=IKnowHesAlive-RisingMalevolence.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Go_Twilight_Go.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Twilight'' flees the ''Malevolence''.]]
After Chancellor Palpatine learned of Skywalker's absence from the command of his battle group, the Chancellor contacted Skywalker and ordered him to cease his search for survivors, as the displacement of his fleet had left other Republic fleets out of position.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> However, Tano was able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] Koon through the Force and took helm control of the ''Twilight'', piloting it toward Koon's location.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> Finding Koon and the clones, the ''Twilight'' deployed its tow cable and pulled the pod and its survivors into its hangar. The clones were tended by a [[TB-2/Legends|medical droid]], while Koon joined Skywalker and Tano on the bridge of the ship, briefing them on the ''Malevolence'' and its ion cannons.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

The ''Twilight''{{'s}} scanners picked up the approaching ''Malevolence''. To avoid detection, Koon quickly ordered all power to be shut down. All systems of the ship were deactivated, including R2-D2; however, the Jedi forgot to power down the medical droid. The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} scanners detected the medical droid, and prepared to confront the survivors. As the warship maneuvered to attack the ship, the Jedi realized that they had overlooked deactivating the medical droid. Immediately restoring all power, Skywalker piloted the ''Twilight'' away from the ''Malevolence'', seeking to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and avoid the Confederate warship's cannons. Koon reactivated R2-D2, and the droid began to plot a hyperspace course out of the system. As the ''Twilight'' began its escape, Grievous ordered the ion cannons to be fired, and as the ion wave approached, Skywalker was able to fly the ''Twilight'' out of the debris field. Skywalker engaged the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine, and the Jedi were able to evade destruction at the hands of the ''Malevolence'', taking the knowledge of the warship's weapons to the Republic.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Your failure is most unfortunate. I will have to ''discuss'' this with my Master.|Count Dooku, to Grievous|audio=YourFailureIsUnfortunate.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_briefs_Shadow_Squadron.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker formulates a plan to assault the ''Malevolence''.]]
The battle caused a ship graveyard to be erected in the Abregado system from the three destroyed Republic cruisers; all of Plo Koon's forces except for three clones and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] himself had been killed. Yet Koon, Skywalker, and Tano were able to give a report to the Jedi Council on the ''Malevolence''. Despite the fact that most of Koon's forces had been eradicated, Dooku considered the battle a defeat because of the Republic's identification of the Confederate weapon. The Sith Lord was extremely displeased with Grievous' failure; his trust in Grievous shaken, Dooku left to discuss plans with his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> Eventually, Grievous continued his flagship's swath of destruction with a [[Battle of the Vanik system|strike]] targeting the [[Vanik system/Legends|Vanik system]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Following the revelation of the ''Malevolence'', Skywalker planned to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|counterattack]] the warship with [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The Jedi took the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] to acquire several experimental Republic [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] from a [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|testing facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] for the attack.<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|obliteration]] of a Republic medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] revealed that Grievous planned to target a secret Republic [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]] near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]. Intending to engage the ''Malevolence'' before it could attack the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|medical base]], Skywalker, accompanied by Tano and Koon, led Shadow Squadron on a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] to intercept the warship.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Abregado<ref name="TCW Activity Annual 2010">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Activity Annual: Summer Edition 2010]]''</ref> was the subject of "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]," an episode featured in the [[October 3]], [[2008]] premiere of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series on [[Cartoon Network]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> The second episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], the episode featured the series debut of Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, Plo Koon, and R2-D2, as well as several other prominent characters such as Obi-Wan Kenobi, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, and Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. The battle also featured the first visual appearance of the ''Malevolence'',<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide" /> having been first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''. The events leading into the episode&mdash;notably, the battle in the Phu system&mdash;were featured in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], released a [[October 2|day before]] the episode's premiere. The battle was officially named in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Activity Annual: Summer Edition 2010]]''.

Although the young readers' book [[The Clone Wars: Meet Ahsoka Tano|''Meet Ahsoka Tano'']] claimed that the Battle of Abregado took place just a few days after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]],<ref name="Meet Ahsoka Tano">''[[The Clone Wars: Meet Ahsoka Tano]]''</ref> this profession interrupted the more drawn-out chronology between the Battle of Christophsis and the events of other episodes of the television series.<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> This article therefore assumes that ''Meet Ahsoka Tano'' is in error.

The reference book ''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]'' erroneously conflates the events of "Rising ''Malevolence''" and the following episode, "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," by mentioning a "rescue mission to the Abregado system" that Skywalker and Tano oversaw with a squadron of BTL-B Y-wing starfighters.<ref name="Blueprints: Rebel Edition">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref>
